name: human-in-the-loop
context: Agents whose actions can have irreversible or high-impact consequences; defined checkpoints require explicit human approval before proceeding.
avoid_when: Actions are fully reversible and low-impact
Production pipelines where automation is mandatory and latency is critical
anti_patterns: Approval required for every trivial step
Gates that trigger 98-99% approval rates unchanged should be auto-promoted (approval fatigue)
design_principles: Approve by risk class, not every step
Per-action confidence thresholds override global thresholds
best_practices: Implement HMAC-signed approved payloads to prevent mutation between review and execution
Capture approvals/rejections as eval data to shrink future queues
Auto-promote gates with >95% approval rate unchanged
references: Wu et al., AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.08155
